headline: Higgsfield raises $400M Series B at $5.4B valuation, quadrupling in 8 months
summary: AI video startup Higgsfield secures $400 million in its Series B funding round, bringing its valuation to $5.4 billion just eight months after its previous $1.3 billion valuation.
details: Higgsfield, an AI company specializing in image and video generation, has announced a $400 million Series B funding round that values the company at $5.4 billion. This significant increase in valuation comes only eight months after the company was valued at $1.3 billion.

Founded in 2023 by former Snap executive Alex Mashrabov, Higgsfield has gained attention for its AI-generated movies showcased at Cannes and in New York. The company offers tools like Cinema Studio for AI film direction and Marketing Studio for advertising teams.

The company reported $700 million in annualized revenue and boasts 30 million users across 200 countries. Higgsfield is also making significant inroads into the enterprise market, working with 390 of the Fortune 500 companies.

Higgsfield anticipates that enterprise adoption of video AI will become increasingly integrated into daily marketing and creative workflows. The new capital will support hiring, product development, and crucially, secure the substantial compute power required for advanced video AI processing.

Video AI generation is highly compute-intensive, with one minute of video comparable to processing 60,000 words. Higgsfield's substantial funding will help it maintain a competitive edge against rivals like Synthesia and Runway by ensuring access to necessary computational resources.
The Series B round was led by DST Global, with participation from other prominent investors including Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Valor Capital, and Tribe Capital.

headline: Dartwords launches: a new daily word game with a Clippy-like AI guide
summary: The Game Band, creators of Blaseball, unveil Dartwords, a web-based daily word puzzle featuring a unique AI hint system and 10 guesses per day.
details: The Game Band, known for the viral hit Blaseball, has launched Dartwords, a new daily word game available on the web. Players have 10 chances to guess a secret word each day, with guidance from a character named Darty.

Darty, inspired by Microsoft's Clippy, provides clues based on player guesses. The game utilizes a custom hint engine powered by a local LLM trained on the English dictionary, offering broader hints that become more specific as players get closer to the answer.

The game's design aims for a more conversational experience than other daily word puzzles like Wordle. Darty's clues are a blend of LLM-generated insights and developer-written hints, creating a unique interactive element.

While the AI assists with hints, the game's art and UI/UX are entirely handmade. The studio also uses AI tools like Claude Code to streamline development tasks, but emphasizes careful human review and taste.

Dartwords enters a crowded market of daily puzzle games, but The Game Band hopes its distinctive AI guide and conversational approach will set it apart. The studio plans to improve the game's clue system over time based on player feedback and data.
